blurb: Carpathian ridgelines, fortified Saxon churches, and a folk-Gothic imagination that never quite went dormant.

trips.title: Transylvania After Dark
trips.summary: Bran Castle by lamplight, wolf-territory hikes, and a candlelit supper in a 14th-century Saxon fortress.
trips.intro: Transylvania is not a set piece. It is a working landscape of shepherds, bear tracks, and villages that have kept the same bell tower for six hundred years. We travel it the way it is best understood — slowly, mostly on foot, and often after dark, when the valleys go quiet and the stories start making sense.
highlights: After-hours access to Bran Castle, lit only by lamps
Two days tracking wolf and bear range with a Carpathian biologist
Candlelit supper inside a 14th-century fortified Saxon church
Night walk through Sighișoara's citadel with a local historian

itinerary.title: Arrive Bucharest
itinerary.body: Airport transfer and an evening walk through the Lipscani quarter. Group dinner in a cellar restaurant beneath the old merchant district.

itinerary.title: North into the Carpathians
itinerary.body: We leave the plain behind and climb the Prahova Valley, stopping at Peleș Castle before continuing to our base in Bran.

itinerary.title: Bran Castle by Lamplight
itinerary.body: Daytime is for the village and its market. After closing, the castle reopens for us alone — no crowds, no electric light, just the corridors and a guide who grew up beneath them.

itinerary.title: Wolf Territory
itinerary.body: A full day in the Piatra Craiului range with a wildlife biologist, reading tracks and scat and, if the season cooperates, watching a valley from a hide at dusk.

itinerary.title: Shepherd's Transhumance
itinerary.body: We walk a stretch of the old migration route with a working shepherd, then eat what the flock provides — fresh telemea, polenta, cold plum brandy.

itinerary.title: The Fortified Churches
itinerary.body: East to the Saxon lands. Viscri and Biertan in the afternoon, then a candlelit supper laid out inside the fortified church at Biertan after the doors close.

itinerary.title: Sighișoara Citadel
itinerary.body: The last inhabited medieval citadel in Europe. A morning of guild towers and covered stairs, then a night walk through the upper town when the day visitors have gone.

itinerary.title: Salt and Descent
itinerary.body: A slow return south, stopping at a working salt mine and a roadside monastery. Final dinner in Brașov's old square.

itinerary.title: Depart Bucharest
itinerary.body: Transfer to Otopeni. Late-afternoon departures recommended.

included: Private after-hours castle and church access
Wildlife biologist and local historian guiding

trips.title: Saxon Villages & Salt Mines
trips.summary: Fortified churches, the vast Turda salt cathedral, and Sighișoara's cobbled old town at blue hour.
trips.intro: A shorter, quieter route through the Transylvanian plateau — the villages the Saxons built and largely left, and the mines beneath them. This is the trip for travellers who would rather spend three hours in one village than ninety minutes in three.
highlights: The Turda salt mine, 120 metres below the plateau
Blue-hour photography in the Sighișoara citadel
A working ceramics kiln in Corund

itinerary.title: Arrive Cluj-Napoca
itinerary.body: Settle into the old Hungarian quarter. Orientation walk and a first dinner in the university district.

itinerary.title: Turda Salt Cathedral
itinerary.body: Descend into the mine — an enormous excavated chamber with a lake at the bottom. We stay long after the tour groups cycle out.

itinerary.title: Onto the Plateau
itinerary.body: East through rolling farmland into Saxon country. Afternoon at Biertan's triple-walled church, evening in a village guesthouse.

itinerary.title: Viscri and Meșendorf
itinerary.body: Two villages, one lime kiln, and a long lunch with the family that restored the blacksmith's house. Optional afternoon walk between the two.

itinerary.title: Sighișoara at Blue Hour
itinerary.body: The citadel in the flat light before the streetlamps come on. A photography-forward day with time built in to simply sit.

itinerary.title: Corund Kilns
itinerary.body: A morning at a working ceramics kiln in the Székely Land, then back west for a final dinner in Cluj.

itinerary.title: Depart Cluj-Napoca
itinerary.body: Transfer to the airport. Morning departures work well from here.

included: Salt mine and fortified church entries
